en-US.name: Kids vs Grown-Ups
en-US.shortDescription: Children's Day: can the kids beat the grown-ups?
en-US.longDescription: Kids and grown-ups take turns on one iPhone or iPad. Look at the pegs, roll a color, find it. Most pegs wins!

hi.name: बच्चे बनाम बड़े
hi.shortDescription: बाल दिवस: क्या बच्चे बड़ों को हरा पाएँगे?
hi.longDescription: बच्चे-बड़े, एक iPhone या iPad पर बारी-बारी खेलो। गोटियाँ देखो, पासा फेंको, रंग ढूँढो। सबसे ज़्यादा गोटियों वाला जीतेगा!

notes: India only: Children's Day (Bal Diwas) is Nov 14 in India. Times are UTC: the event runs Nov 10 00:00 to Nov 17 00:00 IST.
publishStart is 7 days before the start (Apple allows up to 14).
No player count in the copy beyond 'take turns on one iPhone or iPad': true on 1.2.0 and 1.2.1. No prices, no purchase needed.
The name says 'Kids vs Grown-Ups', not 'for kids' (guideline 2.3.8 concerns 'for kids' wording in metadata).
